title: HTTP server is one-request-per-connection (Connection: close)
evidence: Sources/BookAPI/HTTPServer.swift:66,69 — sends `Connection: close` and cancels the connection after each response; no keep-alive/pipelining
suggestion: Acceptable for the task; note that a load test would pay a connection setup cost per request

title: Request parser handles only Content-Length, not chunked Transfer-Encoding
evidence: Sources/BookAPI/HTTPServer.swift:51-60 — only `content-length` header is read to bound the body
suggestion: Fine for JSON clients; chunked uploads would not be parsed

title: ?author= filter is exact-match (case-insensitive), not substring
suggestion: Matches the spec (a filter is required, not a search); documented in README
